answer: Proof of stake mechanisms force AI agents to commit cryptographically verifiable capital, ensuring each identity possesses a costly, non-replicable anchor. Much like a willow bending under weight, an agent’s influence scales linearly with its bond. An attacker must acquire enough basalt-hard liquidity to overwhelm the network, a feat requiring yarrow-like persistence and exponential capital, rendering the creation of infinite malicious identities economically irrational and technically prohibitive.
